tasks.title: Red-team: is the r_R deck-structure choice circular, and does it survive proves-too-much controls?

handoff.objective: Attack whether the r_R candidate definition's choice of the two-pairs/Theta(B^4) deck-pairing reading (over the corpus's declared-matching one-pair/Theta(B^2) reading) is genuinely justified by source text and structure, or is circular; and run the pre-specified proves-too-much control against three named adversarial objects.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether decision-record-among-alternatives.yaml's stated justification for choosing the two-pairs reading would survive being applied blind (i.e. if the declared figure in this corpus had instead been Theta(B^4), would the SAME justification wording have favored the one-pair reading instead?), and whether the candidate definition's support biconditron genuinely fails (as it must) on three named adversarial objects designed so that no pair-pair relation extends the labelling, so that a definition which does NOT fail there is shown to be assuming its conclusion.
inputs: ledger/decisions/DEC-20260830-69bbf7.yaml (the exact bias this Coordinator flagged in the prior round: a reading selected partly because it matches a pre-existing declared figure)
coordination/goals/GOAL-CRYPTO-001/batches/BATCH-001/tasks/TASK-20260722-101/mechanism_note.md (the original two-sentence source text the justification claims to be grounded in)

coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-001/proposals/B71-RCREP-DEFINITION-DRAFT-20260830-351be7/tasks/TASK-20260830-351be7/rcrep-candidate-definition.yaml and decision-record-among-alternatives.yaml (the candidate definition and its stated justification for the choice)
constraints: You are BLIND to TASK-20260830-495939's (validator) report -- do not seek it out, and if you happen to encounter it, disclose it in your attestation rather than silently proceeding.

The circularity attack must be literal: read decision-record-among-alternatives.yaml's justification, then ask, sentence by sentence, whether each stated reason would read equally well (i.e. would still be assertable, unchanged) if the corpus's declared figure had been Theta(B^4) instead of Theta(B^2). If EVERY reason survives this swap test, the justification is not circular even if the swap were run for real (it is genuinely figure-independent). If ANY reason only makes sense given knowledge of which figure was declared, name it explicitly.

Run the proves-too-much control against exactly these three named objects, testing that the candidate definition's construction visibly refuses (r_R has no root at those labels, or the definition is undefined and says so) on each: (1) a labelled configuration built so that NO pair-pair relation extends it (e.g. a forced non-collinear triple over the frozen EXP-CREP-001 instance field, or a deck assignment excluded by the chosen chart convention); (2) a null object of the same shape with the deck-pairing structure removed (the same labels, but decks between which the chosen pairing defines no relation, so there is nothing to eliminate); (3) the OPPOSITE deck-structure reading (one-pair/Theta(B^2), since this draft chose two-pairs) -- the draft's own justification must FAIL to support this opposite reading, since it asserts the opposite reading is wrong; check this directly rather than assuming it.

If the candidate definition still yields a vanishing r_R on any of the first two objects, or if the justification reads equally well for the rejected reading in object (3), the biconditron is being assumed in the setup rather than established -- report this as a genuine failure, not a minor caveat.
Do not change H-CREP-001's status or EXP-CREP-001's specification. Do not create B71, BATCH, IDEA, EV, DEC, CORR, experiment, or implementation records.
No commands, programs, experiments, or computer algebra system execution. Pure mathematical/textual adversarial analysis.

Write attestation.yaml stating: independent_session true, role red-team, requested_policy and resolved_model_id, exact record IDs reviewed, and explicit confirmation you did not read the validator's report.

YAML hygiene is mandatory and will be independently re-checked with a strict parser: no plain scalar may contain an embedded, unescaped double-quote or a colon-followed-by-space -- wrap the ENTIRE scalar in single quotes if either is needed. No duplicated top-level keys at any nesting level, no bare mapping key inside a block sequence without a leading '-'.
deliverables: redteam-report.yaml: the sentence-by-sentence circularity check of decision-record-among-alternatives.yaml's justification, with an explicit verdict (circular / not circular) and reasons.

proves-too-much-control-results.yaml: the result of running the candidate definition's construction against all three named adversarial objects, with an explicit pass/fail per object and the reasoning shown, not merely asserted.
attestation.yaml: independent_session, role, requested/resolved model provenance, record IDs reviewed, and explicit confirmation of no cross-read with the validator.

Gate 2: all three proves-too-much objects are actually constructed and checked against the candidate definition's construction method, with shown reasoning, not asserted results.

Gate 6: every YAML artifact parses under a strict, unforgiving parser.
